title: The + tooltip and menu look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to that staff member.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-07-n1-add-tip.png" (board 1.7) and "card-08-n1-add-menu.png" (board 1.8) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order in that browser window.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the + and compare with the picture of board 1.7.
  2. Click the + and compare with the picture of board 1.8.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tooltip "Add representative" shows where the picture shows it.
  • It does not cover the field.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens below the + with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • The + keeps its light fill.
  • The tooltip is gone, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R2: “At rest the icon is grey on no fill. Hovering the button shows a light fill. The light fill stays while its menu is open.”
  • S2-R3: “Hovering the + shows the tooltip "Add representative". The tooltip does not show while the menu is open.”
  • S2-R4: “Clicking the + opens a menu below it with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts". Clicking outside the menu or pressing Escape closes it without a change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
